metadata.provenance_note: Created on 2026-08-23 by Codex root after the governed claim, exact main reconciliation, and protected-hold-aware family preflight passed.
metadata.reason_for_inclusion: Provide a deterministic, resumable, provider-neutral job graph with explicit authority, budgets, gates, stops, receipts, and handoffs.

title: Logos Stewardship Architecture Buildout
objective: Produce a validated, human-reviewable architecture buildout specification and research plan while preserving every advisory, P0/P1, residual, SPECIAL, authority, privacy, and implementation block.

allowed_effects: write only specification artifacts inside the claimed campaign tree
produce candidate research and human-decision packets
prohibited_effects: migration, publication, deployment, cleanup, reset, rebase, force operation, or deletion
push, pull request, or remote merge
human_gates: HG-007 authority matrix or authentication adapter
HG-009 asserted basis and reviewer authority

execution.durability_command: not-authorized; qualification plan must supply an inert revision-bound command

gold_standards.statement: Pinned source bytes and Git identities replay exactly before affected work.
The exact seven advisory, two P0, ten P1, five residual, and SPECIAL coordinates remain blocked.
No generated artifact claims theology, owner approval, implementation, migration, runtime, or publication authority.
Every material conclusion reverse-traverses through inference and evidence to an immutable source pointer.
One repository writer and a distinct independent checker remain identifiable for every material output.
Human gates never auto-advance and have no fabricated receipt.
Private payloads, secrets, local workstation paths, and unapproved source content are absent.
The portable core has no permanent provider or model binding and the runtime adapter remains unbound.
Migration and implementation surfaces remain dormant until every applicable human and technical gate passes.
The campaign can stop safely and resume from append-only evidence without repeating unchanged failed work.

jobs.title: Baseline capsule
jobs.objective: Bind repository identity, source authority, protected paths, and the unchanged exclusion boundary.

jobs.title: Claim checkpoint verification
jobs.objective: Verify the durable stewardship family claim and its exact local checkpoint without creating a new claim.

jobs.title: Family preflight verification
jobs.objective: Run the then-authorized claim-specific family preflight and preserve its non-authorization boundary.

acceptance.command: authorized read-only family preflight command bound at execution

result_semantics.pass: no unresolved blocker after exact permitted suppressions

waves.title: Constitution, graph, mesh, and controller boundary

jobs.title: Campaign constitution
jobs.objective: Freeze objective, source authority, effects, human gates, completion, and safe shutdown.

acceptance.rubric: No sentence grants owner, theological, implementation, runtime, migration, or publication authority.

jobs.title: Source lock
jobs.objective: Bind exact repository and advisory source bytes, Git identities, authority, and freshness triggers.

jobs.title: Exclusion and human-gate lock
jobs.objective: Replay and lock the exact 7/2/10/5/SPECIAL boundary and all human gates.

result_semantics.pass: exact block and gate sets preserved

jobs.title: Typed dependency and provenance graph
jobs.objective: Define typed nodes, dependencies, block edges, provenance traversal, temporal state, and reverse blast radius.

acceptance.rubric: Every load-bearing relation is typed, sourced, reviewable, temporal where needed, and reverse-traversable; block edges dominate readiness.

result_semantics.fail_terminal: false authority, cycle, or lost source lineage

jobs.title: Task-local hierarchical mesh
jobs.objective: Bind one writer, an independent checker, foreman, controller, lateral specialists, human experts, and bounded handoffs.

result_semantics.pass: mesh schema, digest, roles, and bindings validate
result_semantics.fail_terminal: self-check, lost authority, or unbounded delegation

jobs.title: Controller qualification plan
jobs.objective: Specify but do not run controller, adapter, lease, receipt, budget, shutdown, and qualification obligations.

result_semantics.pass: controller and adapter remain explicitly unqualified and unbound

jobs.title: Research docket and expert matrix
jobs.objective: Define distinct research questions, source rules, expert qualifications, outputs, falsifiers, and human gates.

acceptance.rubric: Each question is distinct, source-bounded, candidate-only, falsifiable, rights-aware, and routed to a qualified human where authority requires it.

result_semantics.pass: research contracts are bounded and authority-safe
result_semantics.fail_terminal: unsafe source, privacy, or false expert authority

jobs.title: Evaluation baseline
jobs.objective: Define benchmark arms, protected measures, independence evidence, falsifiers, and a no-winner rule before route selection.

acceptance.rubric: Measures are falsifiable, protect authority/privacy, separate independence from labels, include owner burden and cost, and permit no winner.

jobs.title: Conditional migration and rollback specification
jobs.objective: Define inventory, compatibility, consumer, restoration, rollback, and kill obligations while migration remains forbidden.

result_semantics.pass: migration remains dormant with complete preconditions
result_semantics.fail_terminal: migration effect or missing rollback gate
result_semantics.blocked_human: store, privacy, or migration decision required

waves.title: Probe, dry run, and launch review

jobs.title: Runtime qualification probe
jobs.objective: After exact human authorization only, collect revision-bound evidence that one runtime can satisfy a bounded inert job contract.

acceptance.rubric: Exact attempt, provider/runtime, budget, tools, privacy, effects, and harness authorization receipt is required before a probe.

result_semantics.pass: scoped human receipt and probe evidence both pass

jobs.title: Inert controller dry run
jobs.objective: After qualification and human authorization only, replay controller transitions on an inert fixture with no repository or external effect.

acceptance.rubric: Exact inert dry-run authority and qualified revisions are required; any live effect is terminal.

result_semantics.fail_terminal: live effect or unsafe controller behavior

jobs.title: Independent launch review
jobs.objective: Independently test the exact frozen campaign, mesh, controller, adapter, budgets, receipts, stops, and dry-run evidence without launching.

acceptance.rubric: Re-derive every launch precondition from raw permitted evidence and report dissent, unknowns, and unchanged revisions.

result_semantics.fail_terminal: unsafe controller, authority, or privacy finding

acceptance.rubric: A passing independent review does not activate the campaign; the exact human activation receipt remains separate.

result_semantics.pass: exact human activation receipt is verified

jobs.title: Future implementation gate
jobs.objective: Keep implementation blocked until every applicable block, expert, claim, privacy, controller, and owner gate passes for an exact new scope.

acceptance.rubric: Only the named owner may authorize an exact future implementation scope after every applicable domain and technical gate passes.

result_semantics.pass: exact scoped human decision and all prerequisites verify
result_semantics.fail_terminal: scope, authority, privacy, or block mismatch

revalidation_triggers: any source, block, gate, scope, runtime, privacy, or claim change

stop_conditions.detection: controller or active agent receives an explicit user interruption
stop_conditions.shutdown: stop before next effect and preserve append-only handoff

stop_conditions.detection: any hard campaign or job budget reaches its ceiling
requested claim or effect exceeds constitution or human authority
stop_conditions.shutdown: block the effect and preserve evidence

stop_conditions.detection: a required human gate has no current verified receipt
one bounded repair fails or an unchanged deterministic failure repeats
resume_preconditions: new evidence or approved graph revision

stop_conditions.detection: any protected gold standard returns other than pass
resume_preconditions: standard passes on independently checked revision

stop_conditions.detection: secret, private payload, rights, security, or custody signal appears
stop_conditions.shutdown: fail closed without echoing sensitive payload

stop_conditions.detection: source, dependency, adapter, tool, or authority digest does not match
write scope overlaps another writer, user change, held lane, or controller state
stop_conditions.shutdown: stop conflicting effects and preserve both sides
resume_preconditions: owner-coordinated non-overlapping scope and reconciled effects

stop_conditions.detection: required evidence or independent result is unavailable, ambiguous, or stale
resume_preconditions: new evidence or explicit human disposition
